subjectDecreeHint: Pick ONE dimension — it decides which hosts may fire the rule. Required, and separate from the Incarnation the reaction runs against.
subjectHintCoven: labels — reaches a host carrying one, and every member of an incarnation carrying one
subjectHintIncarnation: service + name — reaches every host on that incarnation's roster
subjectHintSid: exact SIDs — reaches those hosts and nothing else
subjectHintTrait: key/value — the same two-level reach as coven, on the traits map
subjectVigilHint: Pick ONE dimension — it decides which hosts run the check. Required: a Vigil with no subject reaches no host at all.
vigilsEmpty: No Vigils match the filter. Create via POST /v1/vigils or the button above.
whereEmpty: where not set (fires on any Portent from the Vigil)
